name: Unclear Start Date — User Fails 3 Times
goal: User repeatedly provides unclear travel start date, exceeding max attempts, bot gracefully ends.
constraints: User provides unclear or unparsable start date 3 times.

phases.description: User provides unclear start date 3 times, bot prompts each time.
phases.completionCriteria: After 3rd unclear input, bot says 'try again later' message and ends.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
